card.name: Small words in old narrative prose
card.fires_on: Short linking words (of, his, the, her, our, that, a hyphen) in the middle of a clause in historical, biblical, mythological or literary prose. The next word is usually a noun that the phrase is about to name.

modes.label: Possessives after a verb
modes.description: His, her, our or their right after a verb in a story about people or gods.
modes.example: The dolphin pleaded Neptune's cause so well that she changed<< her>> mind.

modes.label: The or of before a named thing
modes.description: The or of in a fixed phrase, in myth or old-style prose.
modes.example: The Pierides dared to challenge<< the>> Muses on a contest, on which

modes.label: Hyphen in verse ranges
modes.description: A hyphen between chapter and verse numbers in a Bible citation.
